title: AAPF Validation Dataset: Cross-Page-Size ESE Format Changes in Windows Server 2025
description:
Companion artifacts for the paper "Silent Evidence Loss in Windows Server 2025: Cross-Page-Size ESE Format Changes and Their Forensic Integrity Implications" (Forensic Science International: Digital Investigation, 2026).

Includes: (a) source-level patches for libesedb that resolve a previously unreported family of WS2025 itagState reinterpretation failures spanning 4 KiB, 16 KiB, and 32 KiB pages, resolved by a single format-revision-gated patch (a no-op on all pre-WS2025 databases by construction); (b) a Rust-based NTDS.dit analysis tool (Poneglyph) incorporating the universal patch; (c) 14 ESE database samples (ntds.dit, DataStore.edb, WebCacheV01.dat, SRUDB.dat) captured under the Automated Artifact Population Framework on Windows Server 2019 and Windows Server 2025 across Clean, Crashed, and Locked snapshot states; (d) reproduction scripts and pre-computed expected outputs.

See README.md for the full inventory and quick-start instructions, and ETHICAL_USE.md for the intended-use statement.
